description: Creates a new bin (folder) in the project panel to organize media. Nest it by naming a parent: parentBinId (a bin nodeId, unambiguous — preferred) or parentBinName. parentBinName resolves a nested bin too — pass a "/"-separated path like "Scenes/Scene-008" to walk the hierarchy, or a single name to search the whole tree (which fails safely if two bins share that name rather than reparenting to the wrong one).

name.description: The name for the new bin

parentBinId.description: Parent bin nodeId — the unambiguous way to target a nested bin. Takes precedence over parentBinName.

parentBinName.description: Parent bin to create this bin inside, by name. Use a "/"-separated path ("Scenes/Scene-008") for a nested parent, or a single name to deep-search the tree (ambiguous single names are rejected). Ignored if parentBinId is given.

name: create_bin
